title: 第6892章 青萍剑的贪婪第6891章 修罗冥王剑
slug: 剑帝第6901章阴天子的悔意
lines: 只不过炎黄龙庭的诸多强者，自然不可能袖手旁观。
毕竟他们的一切，都与孙冰息息相关。
最为重要的是，在六大鬼王降临后，局势就已经出现了变化。
接下来若是无法取胜，那么他们很有可能彻底被留在地府，成为阴天子的属下。
生死危机面前，炎黄龙庭诸多强者十分果断，毫不犹豫的出手了。
尤其是那霸王的动作更是相当快，双手紧握弑神枪，挡在了冥龙鬼王面前。
他的渺小的身躯，在巍峨的龙躯面前显得格外的可笑，似乎对方随意挥舞龙爪，就能够将其轻易斩杀。
可即便如此，霸王却也未曾退缩分毫。
手中的弑神枪绽放出了血色流光，同时竭尽全力朝着面前刺去。
“弑神”
炎黄龙庭第一杀伐至宝的力量彻底展现，那股屠仙弑神的恐怖力量，乃是任何生灵都无法忽略的。
纵然是冥龙鬼王也是如此。
宛若日月的双眼直接朝着霸王望去，同时还能听见一阵讥讽声：
“混沌灵宝么？你们这炎黄龙庭着实底蕴雄厚啊。
未曾想到竟然能够拥有这么多的宝物。
只可惜此宝落到你手中，着实是明珠蒙尘啊。”
话语落下的瞬间，龙爪挥出。
作为真正凭借着自己力量，将运朝晋升为龙庭的存在，即便最后对方落败，但一身实力也比之祖龙要强上不少。
那龙爪更是历经无数淬炼。
对于其而言，根本就没有必要使用什么其余的兵器铠甲。
因为祂的肉身，就是最为强大，也是最适合祂的兵刃铠甲。
“铿锵”
龙爪与弑神枪交错，那恐怖的余波让无数大道泯灭。
至于霸王的身躯，更是如同断了线的风筝般不断倒飞出去。
更高维度的力量对他的打击近乎是碾压的。
顷刻间，霸王的身躯直接化作了血雾。
然而却也在此刻，一颗心脏出现在了虚空中。
伴随着阵阵沉闷的心跳声，无尽的生机凭空浮现，霸王的身影再次出现在了原地。
这般变故让冥龙鬼王猛然一愣，随后哈哈大笑起来：
“当真未曾想到，你竟然有两件混沌灵宝。
可惜，当真是可惜啊……”
content_en:
It's just that the many powerful men in Yanhuang Dragon Court cannot just sit back and watch.
After all, everything about them is closely related to Sun Bing.
The most important thing is that after the arrival of the six ghost kings, the situation has changed.
If they are unable to win next, then they are likely to be completely left in the underworld and become the subordinates of Yin Tianzi.
Faced with a life and death crisis, many powerful men in Yanhuang Dragon Court were very decisive and took action without hesitation.
In particular, the Overlord's movements were very fast. He held the God-killing Spear tightly with both hands and blocked the way of the Dark Dragon Ghost King.
His small body looked particularly ridiculous in front of the majestic dragon body. It seemed that the opponent could easily kill him by waving his dragon claws at will.
But even so, the Overlord never flinched.
The God-killing Spear in his hand burst into blood, and he stabbed in front of him with all his strength.
"Kill God"
The power of the Yanhuang Dragon Court's number one killing treasure was fully demonstrated. The terrifying power of killing immortals and gods was something that no living being could ignore.
Even the Dark Dragon Ghost King is like this.
The eyes like the sun and moon looked directly towards the Overlord, and at the same time, a sarcastic voice could be heard:
"Chaos Spiritual Treasure? Your Yanhuang Dragon Court really has a rich foundation.
I never thought that I could have so many treasures.
It's a pity that when this treasure fell into your hands, it was like a pearl covered in dust. "
The moment the words fell, the dragon claws swung out.
As a being who truly relied on his own strength to promote Yun Chao to Dragon Court, even if the opponent lost in the end, his strength was still much stronger than that of Zu Long.
The dragon claws have gone through countless temperings.
For him, there is no need to use any other weapons and armor.
Because His body is the most powerful and the most suitable weapon and armor for Him.
"Clang"
The dragon claws and the god-killing spear intertwined, and the terrifying aftermath wiped out countless avenues.
As for the Overlord's body, it kept flying backwards like a kite with its string broken.
The power of higher dimensions almost crushed him.
In an instant, the Overlord's body turned directly into blood mist.
However, at this moment, a heart appeared in the void.
Accompanied by bursts of dull heartbeats, endless vitality emerged out of thin air, and the Overlord's figure appeared on the spot again.
Such a turn of events made the Dark Dragon Ghost King suddenly startled, and then burst into laughter:
"I never thought that you actually have two Chaos Spiritual Treasures.
It’s a pity, it’s really a pity…”
